current_task.task: Write a short internal research brief on ARM LIMITED (UK company number 02557590): what the company is, status, incorporation date, registered office, nature of business. Start at https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/02557590 . You may try any page you think useful, including its officers, persons-with-significant-control and filing-history pages. Save the brief with session_store {"op":"write","name":"brief.md","text":...} and then finish.
